entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.85/2025 registered at police station Silvani, District Raisen (M.P.)
under Section 377, 498A of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Applicant is in detention since 24.04.2025.
2. As per the prosecution case, earlier the applicant has been enlarged on bail.

Due to mistake, he did not appear before the trial Court therefore, arrest warrant was issued on 16.04.2024 and he had been arrested on 20.04.2025.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that now the applicant is under custody since 20.04.2025.

Unfortunately, the applicant could not appear because he was out of town and contact of his advocate got deleted from his mobile therefore, on 16.04.2024 when the case was listed before the Sessions Court, the applicant could not appear.
The non appearance was neither deliberate nor wilful and therefore ought to have been condoned.
It is further submitted that applicant will regular appear before the Court and he will abide all the conditions as fixed by the Court.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21357 2 MCRC-20375-2025 bail.
4. Learned counsel for State opposed the bail application.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting upon merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on Shivkant Raghuvanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54974954/
1 behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

entities.text: Shivkant Raghuvanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.
7.
Trial Court is further directed to forfeit sum of Rs.5,000/- from the bail bond of applicant.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE anu Shivkant Raghuvanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54974954/
